note: The manager owns this file. It is structured ON PURPOSE — the previous loop kept its state as a prose header, which degenerated into a 4,000-character run-on paragraph of abbreviations that no longer carried signal. Structure resists that.

menu.note: The menu is DATA, not prose in a skill file, so the manager can extend it (ladder rung 3). Adding a domain or a kind here is a legitimate strategic move.

kinds.name: New element
kinds.what: a thing the town did not contain

kinds.name: New CA rule
kinds.what: a new per-cell rule that makes the grid evolve

kinds.name: Deepen
kinds.what: make an existing system richer, or wire two together

kinds.name: Connect
kinds.what: link two places or systems that ignore each other

kinds.name: Polish
kinds.what: make what is there read better; add nothing

kinds.name: Interaction/UX
kinds.what: how you read, poke or navigate the diorama

kinds.name: Scale/World
kinds.what: change the size, span or time of the world itself

kinds.name: Harness
kinds.what: the loop's own instruments — gates, probes, runlog, stats. Changes nothing a viewer sees, and does NOT count toward a domain's balance

coverage.note: domain -> kind -> iteration numbers. Pre-loop work (CHANGELOG iterations 1-31, hand-driven) is recorded as `pre` so the manager knows the ground it stands on.

inventory.note: What the town ALREADY CONTAINS, in the words a brief would use. NOUNS, not histories — numbers and measurements belong in the ledger. Read this before you build: it is the antidote to the previous loop's terminal failure, nine iterations that each surveyed the world, found everything already existed, and exited.
courtyard: walled garden, organic bed ring, four arch entrances (2 TUNNEL, 2 SLOT), benches, desire paths from foot wear, daisies, ivy on the gatehouse, a pre-dawn sweeper, one linden (drawTree, CX/CY)
planting CA — 11 species, bloom stages, seeding from mature neighbours, crowding, age dieback; rain accelerates every growth term

the beds read the YEAR — growF()/dieF()/bloomCap() off warmth, lawn health in groundCol; bloomCap is a CEILING, and per-cell hardiness holds ~1/7 of cells at it, so winter is blooms scattered in turned earth. probes/beds-year.mjs
the path ring answers a touch — PAVING.court, the largest single place in the town

the naming — the thing under the pointer is named in the sill (borrows the ticker's box; a TAP names on a phone). Species+stage read off bSp/bSt against bedCap(x,y), allotments per PLOT off plotCrop, places off pavingAt/WATERS, 13 trees hit-tested in SCREEN space against crowns[] the draw pass records. Settles 0.12s, yields to a live ticker line, silent under inviteHold. probes/naming.mjs, naming-shots.mjs
lane: kiosk, pavement cafe with claimable tables, awnings, washing lines, planters, street lamps, benches
market day every 4th day, three stalls; marketRaise(i) stages each stall up and down as clamps on one 0..1 progress
washing comes in before the rain — per-garment thresholds on weatherComing(), plus a dusk ramp; never all in one frame

the working day hangs off the SUN — kioskOpen/marketOpen/marketClose/marketRaise/sweeper/wind announcement are offsets from sunUp/sunDown. MK_MIN_SPAN floors winter at 7 h; MK_EARLIEST keeps the summer raise inside its own sim day. probes/working-day.mjs

the stalls sell what the plots grew — produce[] is written only by harvestPlot(), stockMarket() latches it ONCE per market day at the first trestle and empties it into mkShelf; marketRaise(i) gates on mkTrades(i) (MK_NEED [0,4,13] units) so a thin year brings out one or two stalls and stall 0 can stand behind an empty board. Each pitch is a real vegetable in its own colour and size (MK_R); half the surplus over MK_CAP 18 keeps to the next market; mkLine() names the crop. census planting.produce. probes/market-year.mjs, market-shots.mjs
street: cross street with two footways, roadway, curbs, street lamps, four street trees in stone pits (TREE_PITS, drawLaneTree)
allotment block of 17 plots, timber fence, gates, shed, an alley cut through the block
harvest cycle — harvestPlot() lifts a mature 3x2 bed whole, bAge doubles as a 12-20 s fallow clock, then re-sown as a row under plotCrop(). census planting.harvested
spawnAllotAgent() — the allotments own arrival source, rate on ripePlots(); ~1.1 gardeners/day, ~1 plot cleared/day, out again carrying a basket (a.crop)

seasonal canopy on all 13 trees — leafOut/leafFresh/leafDeep/leafTurn/leafShed + leafCol(base,k), bare in winter behind drawBoughs(), patchy amber in autumn; reads seasonPhase. leafFallF() drives the falling leaves. probes/canopy-year.mjs, probes/year-strip.mjs
orchard year on the fruit:1 flag — blossomF() (white crown, out ahead of the leaves) and fruitF() (green->red, gone before the tree is bare)

winter hardiness is grain-matched to the PLOT — SPECIES.hardy:1 (cabbages), plotStands(x,y) off plotCrop(), and caTick ceiling = cap===3 ? 3 : inAllotment ? (plotStands?3:cap) : (hash>0.86?3:cap). Which plots stand rotates with the harvest. probes/allot-year.mjs, probes/allot-shots.mjs
plaza: plaza with a fountain and a paved roundel (PATH), four tree pits, benches; quay with benches along the river

spawnEastAgent() — the east quarters own arrival source (eastCap/eastRate, a.east, excluded from laneCount, eastOpen() on daylight>0.16); enters by the alley, the quay head or the park gate, visits one stop, leaves the way it came. census life.inEast

PAVING + pavingAt(x,y) — the ONE predicate naming which paving a cell is: lane, bridge, cross street, mouth, plaza, quay, towpath, court. Each carries its own crumbs line AND the box its birds land in; crumbSpot() staggers three birds and its optional keep rect shoves the scatter CENTRE clear of the fountain basin, read off the grid by waterBox(). probes/paving-places.mjs, probes/crumb-birds-seen.mjs
river: river, one rowboat, three-arch bridge, towpath, church with tower and nave, bandstand, four orchard trees, jetty, park gate
pigeons that flush off the belfry when the bell rings, from a finite roost that refills

byTheWater() — the ONE predicate for the three places a person can see the river (quay and rail, bridge deck, towpath). boatWatch() is its only reader; a future river event should read it, not re-derive it
boatWatch() — one glance per passing boat (a.watch ~1.4 s, ticked at the top of stepAgent so it never holds anybody); ~2.1 glances per boat
a parapet stop mid-span (PARAPET_Y, PARAPET_Z 1.0), served mainly from spawnEastAgent; somebody on the bridge ~12% of daylight

the water reads the YEAR — riverRun() (1 + RIVER_SWING*greyF(), exactly 1 at SEASON_START) drives drawRiverFlow(t): drift speed, streak count, streak length, the channel colour (riverCol -> RIVER_COLD/RIVER_GREEN) and the width of the deep mid-channel. probes/river-year.mjs, probes/river-shots.mjs

the rowboat is a fair-weather thing — boatRate() thins as the water rises (BOAT_SWING 0.75, BOAT_FLOOR 0.0065 binding through winter so boatWatch() never dies), boatSpeed() takes BOAT_DRIFT 0.24 of the current. ONE boat only, so the year reads as PRESENCE, not boats/day
sky: day/night cycle (55 s day), sun and moon arc, backdrop hills, night window lighting, chimney smoke, a balloon
isWindy() — wind days, already read by the ticker, leaf fall, smoke drift, tree sway, the washing line swing and the morning wind announcement
cloudCover() — one slow rate-capped scalar; fronts build over ~half a day and break after rain; sun and moon veiled, stars put out, drifting banks
weatherComing() — the ramped rain-is-coming predicate off cloudCover(), damped by daylight because people anticipate by looking up; three readers at their own trigger points
rainFall — a 0..1 shower intensity beside the raining boolean; drops, the overcast tint, pond rings, water sparkle and chimney smoke all read it

season() — the YEAR. A cyclic scalar over SEASON_LEN 26 days (~24 real min), phase 0 = midwinter, anchored at SEASON_START 0.25 where every seasoned term equals the constant it replaced. NINE READERS: day length, light, the courtyard beds, all 13 trees, the working day, the population caps, the weather fronts, the river, the allotment ceiling. census clock.season

the weather reads the year — greyF() drives front frequency, depth and spellLen() (winter a low grey lid, summer mostly clear) while showerRate/showerLen/showerHard move the OPPOSITE way, so summers rare showers are the hard ones and the annual total holds. Rain can start in the dark (nightDamp, NIGHT_RAIN 0.12). probes/weather-year.mjs

the ground reads the lid — shadowF() (SH_KNEE 0.32, SH_FULL 0.94, SH_FLOOR 0.20) with shSpread() and shOffset(), so a cast shadow fades, widens and retracts together. Eight sites; a REAL blur on the cached ground layer behind CAN_BLUR. probes/shadow-cover.mjs, probes/ground-relight.mjs

the sill NAMES the year — seasonLabel(), the sibling of timeLabel(): eight names on seasonPhase (never warmth, which hits 0.5 twice), sectors of 1/8 CENTRED on their phase so midwinter is one continuous name across the wrap and Spring lands on SEASON_START. #season in the sill, serif beside the plate; below 640px it drops into the plate's caption slot and reads as a museum label under the title. #stats now yields below 860px so the sixth item does not starve the ticker. probes/sill-year.mjs

a ResizeObserver on the canvas frame — the sill BORROWS space (naming, invitation), which resizes the picture +16px at 390px with no resize event, and unproject() was landing 2 cells out at the bottom of the frame

the sill's season is a BUTTON — clicking it runs the town on to the next quarter as a sub-stepped fast-forward, never a jump. stepSkip()/simSub()/skipEase(): SKIP_SUB 0.25 sim s, a flat-topped trapezoid advanced off its exact integral, lands on a WHOLE number of sim days so the hour survives (7+6+7+6 = 26 = SEASON_LEN, four clicks close the year exactly). The lapse OWNS the clock — speed and Pause are suspended for its few seconds and speed is never written. announce() is deaf throughout; land() says one line. RM takes an honest cut behind #veil instead of a six-sunrise time-lapse. probes/season-skip.mjs, skip-strip.mjs, skip-shots.mjs
life: walkers with itineraries, courtyard and street; eastern itineraries — plaza bench, fountain gaze, quay rail, quay bench, towpath, church green, allotment plot, bridge parapet
cafe sitters who claim and release a table; market and kiosk browsers; ducks, swans, butterflies, fireflies, birds, one night cat, falling leaves
a clock that strikes and a church bell that answers it at nine and eighteen from day 2; walkers break stride and look up while it rings (a.listen)
greetPass — two passing within 0.9-1.6 cells may stop, turn and talk (a.greet, chatCool); ~2 conversations a minute

EVERY sitter reads the sky, street and courtyard alike — SIT_REFUSE 0.42 turns a seat down, skyLifts(a) gives one up over 0.55..0.88 off a per-agent a.wary; umbrellas up over 0.62..1.17. ONE predicate each, and the gate is what you are DOING, not a.street: on the street everyone not lying down, in the courtyard the people SITTING, so the napper sleeps on and the gardener finishes the row. A refused courtyard seat routes to the exit (routeToExit) instead of despawning on the lawn — a picnic pair judges the sky ONCE for both (a.mate) and never splits. Under cover>0.60 the courtyard sits 0.074 vs 0.269 on the old build, a blue sky is unchanged. probes/seats-out.mjs, seats-shots.mjs

THE DIORAMA IS CLICKABLE and says so once — a bed takes seeds of a real species, the lawn a daisy, the pond crumbs, the fountain a coin, the river a pebble, paving crumbs. answersTouch(x,y) is the ONE predicate (BED/CBED/GRASS/WATER/SIDE/ROAD/PATH), ~64% of the frame; cursor and handler both read it. ONE invitation, once ever, at 8 REAL seconds. probes/touch-hint.mjs
the ticker is an ordered queue, not an overwrite — TICK_DWELL 2.5 real s, cap 2, 6 s staleness cut; a follow-on enqueues only when its antecedent is DISPLAYED (lineDwell)

the SILL under the canvas — #plate, #daytime ("Day 12 · Afternoon", names the day and the hour and never the season), #ticker, #stats ("N people · N blooms"), #ctrl (Pause, speed 1x/3x/8x). Ticker and stats hidden under 640px except during the invitation
__entities() carries role, act, watch and raindrops per person — the seam a behaviour probe reads instead of a bespoke hook

yearBusy(ex) multiplies the DAYLIGHT term of capacity/laneCap/eastCap only, never their fixed share (EX_COURT 0.5, EX_LANE 1.0, EX_EAST 1.25; eastCap keeps Math.min(7,...)). POP_FLOOR 8 + scarcity lifts the three arrival RATES only. probes/season-year.mjs

openCues.note: East agents retrace their inbound route exactly, so arrivals sharing a gate walk single-file and would read as a queue if eastCap rose above 7. Still UNWATCHED: nobody has looked at a summer afternoon at the park gate.

scarcity (POP_FLOOR rail) also fires in the first sim minute when the town is legitimately empty, so the opening fill is hurried vs HEAD. maturity() still bounds it, but minute one is a servo rather than a ramp.

Winter sits above the umbrella band far more of the time (weather-year.mjs: winter 38.1% / summer 7.7%, annual mean 20.5%, redistributed not added). Nobody has looked at whether a courtyard of umbrellas under a lid that never breaks reads as care or as a false promise.

FRONT_DEEP lets deep-winter cover clamp at a saturated 1.000 for whole spells. Nothing downstream misbehaves, but no drawn term has range left above ~0.95, so a future how-heavy-is-this-lid signal cannot be read off cover alone.

The 0.9-cell spread is a guarantee at SPAWN only: birds hop a +/-0.4 random walk with no separation term, and a pair measured 0.2 cells apart 1.8 s after landing. Pre-existing and as true on the lane as anywhere.

bloomCap() is the towns only STEPPED seasonal term (3/2/1) while growF/dieF are lerps: allotment ripeness falls off a cliff at the autumn shoulder, folded 12.53 -> 5.52 -> 2.45 in two sim days. The winter tail is soft now; the entry into it is not.

the sill overflows its box at 320px — 44px on HEAD before this iteration, pre-existing and untouched. 390 is the tracked framing; if a narrower one is ever added, the fix is the same caption-slot move applied to #daytime.

The naming names places and plants, not PEOPLE. Walkers, ducks, swans, the sweeper and the boat all pass under the pointer and answer with the ground they stand on. __entities() already carries every one with a stable id, and crowns[] is the pattern — let the draw pass record where it painted a thing.

The season button is advertised only by a chevron and a pointer cursor. The one-time invitation covers the CANVAS; nothing tells a viewer the sill answers too, and on a phone it is 10px uppercase in the caption slot. Midwinter is 19.6 real seconds away and nobody is told.

On a ?pause page the sill's TEXT never refreshes: refreshStats() runs from statAcc += dt with dt 0, and the load-time call happens before updateClock(), so a ?t=175&pause page reads 'Day 1 · Dawn' while __census() says day 3. Pre-existing, verified identical on HEAD, harness-only — but any future gate that reads the sill DOM instead of the hook will be reading the opening frame.

The initial scatter puts flowers into allotment beds (seed 42 opens with a fern in the block, seed 7 a fern and a lavender), so a fern can be harvested, ride the basket and reach a market board. speciesFor() only filters NEW sowing, not the opening scatter.

Drawing consumes R(): on a ?pause page frozen at simT 300, R() reads 0.110 after 2 drawn frames and 0.746 after 40. Every probe that round-trips to the host between measurements (screenshot, boundingBox, waitForFunction) is walking the seeded stream by however many frames the machine delivered. Pre-existing and untouched; several probes in probes/ round-trip.

The picnic pair now shares one decision but still has two independent sit TIMERS (each half draws 20+R()*14 on arrival), so on a clear day one half can get up and walk out while the other stays on the blanket. The sky can no longer split a pair; an ordinary afternoon still can.

state.json has TWO cues numbered c11 in closedCues (one raised at #4 and closed at #8, one raised at #5 and closed at #25). Cue ids are not unique, so a brief that names a cue by id alone is ambiguous.

watch.note: The whole east half is fed by a single spawnLaneAgent roll under one laneCap. Anything you add out there competes for that one budget — check whether your feature needs its own arrival source before concluding nobody uses it. Bands, measured: cross-street 0.30 of spawns, market 0.24, kiosk 0.18, cafe 0.26, allotment to 0.48, plaza to 0.48, quay 0.48-0.53, green 0.53-0.58. laneCap peaks at 9 in full daylight.

THE YEAR IS BUILT AND NOBODY CAN SEE IT. Nine systems read season(), but the year is 26 sim days = ~24 real minutes, so a thirty-second viewer sees 2% of it — and the sill names the day and the hour and has never named the season. Every seasonal iteration from #12 to #25 is addressed to an observer with no way to reach it. This is why pass #25 climbed to rung 5.

The market is the last flat system: three stalls, every 4th day, identical in February and August, and nothing connects it to the allotments that now grow and are picked next door. b28 spends it — when it lands, delete this note.
